FAQ

Is it really half? Of everything?

Yes. Half of your current agency's monthly fee, for comparable scope.

My agency charges a percentage of ad spend.

We charge half that percentage.

My invoice includes SEO, social media or other services.

We take over all of it, at half the total fee.

What's not included?

Digital execution is included. Physical production (shoots, camera crews, models, studios) is excluded.

Is there a minimum?

No. Half means half.

Does my ad spend change?

No. Your ad budget goes directly to Meta and Google. We only replace the agency fee.

What happens after 12 months?

Your launch rate is locked for the first 12 months. After that, we'll talk based on results.

Who gets the 50% launch rate?

The first 5 qualifying US med spa partners.

Do you have med spa results yet?

Not in the US yet, and we won't pretend otherwise. On the call, we'll walk you through real results from brands we manage today. That's why our first 5 med spa partners get 50% off and can test us on one treatment line before switching anything else.

Where are you based?

Our team works across Canada and India, serving med spas across the US and Canada. You get a direct line to your strategist, on your time zone.
